findings.title: Adverse-weather runtime robustness is under-specified

findings.title: 5-minute root-cause target needs an explicit latency strategy
findings.explanation: The design has the right components for correlation and ranking, but it does not specify partitioning, precomputation, prioritization, or other mechanisms that demonstrate the end-to-end RCA loop can reliably complete within the 5-minute constraint at the stated scale.
findings.recommendation: Define the hot path and its latency budget, including event partitioning, lookback windows, and any precomputed graph or anomaly indices used to keep investigation turnaround under 5 minutes.

findings.title: Top-3 accuracy target needs a measurable acceptance gate
findings.explanation: Offline training and registry promotion are present, but the submission does not state how candidates are evaluated, thresholded, or rolled back to ensure the top-3 suggestions exceed 80% accuracy in practice.
findings.recommendation: Add a concrete evaluation and promotion policy, such as a held-out incident set, top-3 hit-rate reporting, and promotion thresholds tied to the registry before a model is served.
